verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents custom risk rules, ML scoring, risk lists, and a device data collection SDK. Nothing shows the risk engine accepting verified agent identity as a risk signal: no agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes. The MCP server is an LLM tooling feature, not an agent-identity input to risk decisions, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
